---

### **Hypothesis:**
*"In an adversarially trained malware detection system using a deep neural network (e.g., MalConv or a transformer-based model), increasing the diversity and volume of adversarial examples in the training dataset (e.g., FGSM, PGD, or GAN-generated perturbations) will improve the system’s resilience to evasion attacks—measured by a reduction in the attack success rate (ASR) of gradient-based adversarial malware (e.g., APT malware variants) by at least 20%—but may degrade benign classification accuracy by no more than 5% when tested on
</explanation>
